regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, Supporting Information badge, and left-column literature overview
regions.finding: Article metadata and high-level claims were reviewed. Prior-work examples are cited literature rather than experiments newly reported in this paper; the SI badge/statement does not establish an associated SI file.
Three distinct directing-group substrates are depicted; adjacent prose says these screened directing groups failed to initiate the allene reactions. Three partial failed-screen records were retained.

regions.region: page 1 right-column optimization prose below Figure 1
regions.finding: Two distinct Table S1 results are reported in prose: toluene/room-temperature entry 1 (3aa 55%, 4aa 7%, no cyclization) and the optimized −20 °C MeOH/H2O entry 7 (3aa 82%, 3aa/4aa >20/1). They were not merged with Table 1 entry 1.

regions.region: page 1 lower-right scope discussion continuing onto page 2
regions.finding: Narrative support was linked to the corresponding Table 1 rows for halo, CF3, and naphthyl substrates; the table rows remain the experiment units.

unresolved: Table S1 and the experimental SI were not supplied or explicitly associated.
Figure 1 failure conditions, partner identities, scale, and analytical basis are missing.

regions.region: page 2 left column, Table 1 reaction drawing, entries 1–18, and footnotes a–g
regions.finding: Eighteen monoallylation scope experiments were retained row-by-row, including row-specific temperatures, isolated mono-product yields, crude 1H NMR diallylation yields/ratios, explicit no-diallylation footnote results, and the ambiguous table dashes in entry 18.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right, Table 2 reaction drawing, entries 1–5, and DCE footnote
regions.finding: Five diallylation experiments were retained separately; entry 3 uses DCE and all reported yields are isolated yields.

regions.region: page 2 center-right prose on tetrasubstituted allenes and substrate 1m
regions.finding: A class-level tetrasubstituted-allene failure and the very slow 1m reaction giving at least three products were preserved as partial/unresolved results rather than assigned invented structures.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Scheme 1, two solvent rows
regions.finding: The DCE (3la/4la = 0%/79%) and MeOH/H2O (47%/36%) conditions are distinct experiments and were retained separately.

regions.region: page 2 bottom-right prose introducing eqs 1–2 and Scheme 2 on page 3
regions.finding: The lactonization, NIS cyclization, and chirality-transfer experiments continue visually on page 3; their records cite both pages rather than being duplicated.

unresolved: Tables 1 and 2 omit reaction times and most operational details.
Scheme 1 does not state yield basis or reaction time; the prose/figure substrate label is OCR-prone, while the scheme identifies 1l.
The SI-directed details for substrate 1m are unavailable.

regions.finding: Two distinct experiments were retained: the two-stage 3aa/2e allylation-lactonization to 5ae (83%) and NIS cyclization of 3aa to 9aa (68%).

regions.region: page 3 left-center Scheme 2 reaction drawing and four-row chirality-transfer table
regions.finding: Four experiments were retained row-by-row with starting-allene ee, product identity, yield, and product ee; missing stage times were not inferred.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left equations (3)–(6) and KIE prose
regions.finding: Four separate isotope/KIE experiments were retained, including durations, yields, deuterium incorporation, product ratios, and kH/kD statements without conflating isotopomer ratios with KIE values.

regions.region: page 3 upper-right Scheme 3 and mechanistic discussion
regions.finding: The cyclic Rh intermediates M1–M3/M2′ and their arrows are explicitly proposed; one mechanism record was created and not treated as an observed experiment.
The paper states that experimental procedures and spectra are in Supporting Information, but no SI file was supplied or associated in this workspace.

unresolved: Yield measurement bases and most workup/purification details are absent from the main text.
Several stereochemical and isotopologue structures are retained by label and remain machine-unverified.
Proposed mechanistic intermediates were not experimentally isolated.

regions.finding: The page contains bibliography entries only. These are cited prior literature, not experiments newly reported in this paper, so no current-paper experiment records were created from this page.

unresolved: Bibliographic citations were not expanded into external-paper reaction records because only this paper's supplied source evidence is in scope.
